title: Advantech WebAccess/NMS MibBrowser SQL Injection Information Disclosure Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to disclose sensitive information on affected installations of Advantech WebAccess/NMS. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the processing of calls to the handleTargetsByDeviceName method of the MibBrowser class. When parsing the deviceName parameter of the targets endpoint, the process does not properly validate a user-supplied string before using it to construct SQL queries. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to disclose file contents in the context of SYSTEM.
